detectors.name: Ingress/Gateway Collision
detectors.rationale: Overlapping hostnames or paths in Ingress/Gateway resources cause non-deterministic routing.

detectors.name: Orphaned Backend
detectors.rationale: Ingress backend points to a Service that does not exist in the manifest set.

detectors.name: Localhost Trap
detectors.rationale: Service targeting 127.0.0.1/localhost will fail to reach containers in other pods.

detectors.name: Service Shadowing
detectors.rationale: Multiple Services sharing the same selector may lead to unintended traffic distribution.

detectors.name: Shadowing Endpoint
detectors.rationale: Endpoints manually defined for a Service that also has a selector will be overwritten.

detectors.name: Circular Service Ref
detectors.rationale: Service selector matches its own pod, creating a routing loop.

detectors.name: Identity Context Gap
detectors.rationale: Missing securityContext in Pod/Container allows pods to run with excessive permissions.

detectors.name: Pull-Safe Hazard
detectors.rationale: ImagePullPolicy should be 'Always' for ':latest' tags to prevent stale image execution.

detectors.name: Namespace Pollution
detectors.rationale: Resources defined without an explicit namespace can end up in 'default', causing collisions.

detectors.name: Binding Conflict
detectors.rationale: RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding with overlapping subjects and roles can lead to privilege escalation.

detectors.name: Role/RBAC Collision
detectors.rationale: Multiple Roles defining the same permissions in the same namespace are redundant.

detectors.name: StringData Leakage
detectors.rationale: Raw strings in Secret 'data' fields must be base64 encoded or moved to 'stringData'.

detectors.name: Privilege Escalation
detectors.rationale: allowPrivilegeEscalation: true allows a child process to gain more privileges than its parent.

detectors.name: Root User Hazard
detectors.rationale: Containers running as root (UID 0) are a significant security risk.

detectors.name: Invisible Outage
detectors.rationale: Mismatched Service and Workload ports cause silent traffic loss.

detectors.name: Ingress backend mismatch
detectors.rationale: Ingress must point to a valid Service and Port to avoid 404/503 errors.

detectors.name: Service Shadowing
detectors.rationale: Two services with identical selectors cause non-deterministic routing.

detectors.name: Unsatisfiable LoadBalancer
detectors.rationale: type: LoadBalancer requires a cloud provider or controller to avoid permanent <pending> status.

detectors.name: ExternalName Loop
detectors.rationale: Recursive DNS lookups can saturate CoreDNS and cause cluster-wide outages.

detectors.name: Host Network Exposure
detectors.rationale: Using hostNetwork allows the pod to access all network traffic on the node.

detectors.name: Host Path Exposure
detectors.rationale: hostPath volumes allow containers to access sensitive files on the host filesystem.

detectors.name: Webhook Brownout
detectors.rationale: Missing timeoutSeconds or failurePolicy: Fail can cause cluster-wide API latency.

detectors.name: Webhook Target Collision
detectors.rationale: Multiple webhooks targeting the same service/path can cause conflicting mutations.

detectors.name: Scaling War
detectors.rationale: Defining replicas in Deployment while an HPA is active causes the cluster to 'fight' itself.

detectors.name: Affinity Deadlock
detectors.rationale: podAntiAffinity with 'requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution' can prevent all pods from starting.

detectors.name: PDB Overlap
detectors.rationale: Multiple PodDisruptionBudgets targeting the same pods can cause eviction deadlocks.

detectors.name: Resource Logic Error
detectors.rationale: Resource requests cannot be greater than limits.

detectors.name: Liveness Aggression
detectors.rationale: Liveness probes with low initialDelay can kill apps before they finish booting.

detectors.name: Sidecar Race-Condition
detectors.rationale: Missing preStop hooks in sidecars can lead to traffic loss during pod termination.

detectors.name: Grace Period Mismatch
detectors.rationale: terminationGracePeriod must be long enough for the app to flush buffers and close connections.

detectors.name: Proportional Resource Hazard
detectors.rationale: High CPU limits paired with low Memory limits increase the risk of Burst OOM during processing spikes.

detectors.name: Topology Deadlock
detectors.rationale: maxSkew: 1 on small clusters (e.g. 2 nodes) can prevent scaling beyond node count.

detectors.name: Immutable Field Drift
detectors.rationale: Changing immutable fields like 'spec.selector' in a Deployment will cause apply failures.

detectors.name: Floating Tag Hazard
detectors.rationale: Using tags like ':v1' or ':stable' is non-deterministic and makes rollbacks difficult.

detectors.name: Mount-Path Collision
detectors.rationale: Mounting multiple volumes to the same path will hide previously mounted data.

detectors.name: Orphaned StorageClass
detectors.rationale: StorageClasses with no associated PVCs or PVs are potential clutter.

detectors.name: Dangling PV
detectors.rationale: PersistentVolumes without a claim (PVC) are consuming resources without being used.

detectors.name: Dangling CRD
detectors.rationale: CustomResourceDefinitions with no active instances may be leftovers from uninstalled apps.

detectors.name: Dangling Identity
detectors.rationale: ServiceAccounts not referenced by any Pods increase the attack surface.

detectors.name: Reserved Label Pollution
detectors.rationale: Using 'kubernetes.io/' or 'k8s.io/' labels for internal logic is prohibited.

detectors.name: PriorityClass Collision
detectors.rationale: Multiple PriorityClasses with the same value cause non-deterministic scheduling priority.

detectors.name: Cluster-Scope Safety
detectors.rationale: Namespace-scoped resources referenced in Cluster-scoped roles can lead to security leaks.

detectors.name: API Deprecation Prediction
detectors.rationale: Predicting when an API version will be removed based on target cluster version.

detectors.name: Missing Resource Limits
detectors.rationale: Unbounded containers can cause node-wide OOM events and starve other pods.

detectors.name: Missing Probes
detectors.rationale: Pods without Readiness/Liveness probes are difficult to manage during rollouts.

detectors.name: Read-Only Root FS
detectors.rationale: Enforcing a read-only root filesystem prevents attackers from persisting binaries.

detectors.name: ServiceAccount Auto-Mount
detectors.rationale: Disabling auto-mount for the default ServiceAccount token reduces token exposure.

detectors.name: Capabilities Hazard
detectors.rationale: Adding sensitive capabilities like 'SYS_ADMIN' or 'NET_ADMIN' increases pod risk.

detectors.name: GitOps Controller Default Drift
detectors.rationale: Omitting live controller defaults causes perpetual sync-flapping in ArgoCD and Flux.

detectors.name: Unordered Sync-Wave Hazard
detectors.rationale: Deploying CustomResources before CustomResourceDefinitions crashes admission without sync waves.

detectors.name: StatefulSet Volume Immutability Crash
detectors.rationale: In-place mutations to StatefulSet volumeClaimTemplates trigger fatal Kubernetes admission rejections.

detectors.name: HA Topology Spread Fake-Out
detectors.rationale: Multi-replica workloads without topologySpreadConstraints risk simultaneous failure during single-zone outages.

detectors.name: Protocol Contract Mismatch
detectors.rationale: gRPC and WebSocket services require explicit appProtocol and Ingress annotations to avoid HTTP 502 errors.

detectors.name: Ingress Path Shadowing Blackhole
detectors.rationale: Broad Ingress path prefixes swallow specific sub-paths, causing silent 404 routing blackholes.

detectors.name: BestEffort QoS OOM Eviction Hazard
detectors.rationale: Containers lacking resources are assigned BestEffort QoS and terminated first under memory pressure.

detectors.name: Dual-Stack IPv6 Service CIDR Clashes
detectors.rationale: Omitting ipFamilyPolicy on LoadBalancer Services defaults to SingleStack, causing silent traffic blackholes on dual-stack clusters.

detectors.name: Deprecated Ingress NGINX Configuration Snippet
detectors.rationale: Mitigation for CVE-2021-25742 disables configuration-snippet by default; requires migration to native Ingress annotations.

detectors.name: HPA vs VPA Autoscaler Metric Contention
detectors.rationale: Simultaneous horizontal and vertical autoscaling on identical metrics creates destabilizing thrashing loops and pod OOM crashes.

detectors.name: Sync-Wave Inversion Hazard
detectors.rationale: Workload sync-wave is less than or equal to a referenced dependency (ConfigMap/Secret), risking crashloop admission crashes.
